{{Top|leg}}
After [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] [[Subjugation of Mon Calamari|conquest of]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attempted to make a Imperial-Calamari style ship, but Imperial [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] struggled to adapt Mon Calamari tools and equipment. This was an impossible task, as everything from smelting techniques to arcfusers were designed for Mon Cal and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] physiology. As such, [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] deemed it a failure, as it had been expensive and proved to be impossible.
